_readme: MHCR jobs. Frames run in viewer order (first photo ... finished); the LAST shown frame must be 'after' (the tile/dial photo). Each shown frame of a published job has 4 files in images/jobs/<slug>/<frame>-{m-800,m-1200,d-1600,d-2400}.webp (made by _build/tools/import_job_images.py; templates use {{pic slug/frame}}). page = the job page path (Phase 05 builds it; slugs from the phase file). category = a service name from services.json. buildup = 'film' (Fireplace 1's stone film), 'frames' (pinned step-through of the frames) or null (before/after only). meta_title / meta_description / summary / did = the job page copy, verbatim from the copy deck §6 (confirmed facts only). pos = default object-position for the photo's crop (optional). hold = frame kept in the data but never shown (reason given). publish:false = no job page and not in the jobs index (its photos may still be used, e.g. Kitchen 1 on the Dial). photos:false = never shown anywhere: no images imported and {{pic}} refuses it (Bathroom 3, Fireplace 3). provenance: owner photo IMG number + what was done (feeds the Terms photo line). Alt text: plain descriptions, confirmed facts only; copywriter may tighten. NEVER add Kitchen 1 IMG_9626-9630 / IMG_0029 or Bathroom 3 IMG_9638-9640 (MLS listing photos).
